title: Private deployment compatibility harness and rollout sentinel for orchestrated migrations
creator: Marisol Vega
description:
Problem: Private (VPC/on-prem) customers require deterministic, auditable upgrade runs that can safely apply schema changes, runtime binary swaps, and model bundle updates across heterogeneous clusters. Existing ad-hoc scripts and one-off playbooks are error-prone, lack measurable preflight checks, and do not provide a standardized rollback / canary circuit for LTS channel promotion.

Goal: Ship a lightweight compatibility harness + rollout sentinel that sits in the Private control plane and coordinates orchestrated migrations. The harness will run preflight probes (API compatibility, schema dry-run, KV cache translation smoke tests), collect migration telemetry, and produce a signed compatibility artifact. The rollout sentinel consumes artifacts to execute staged rollouts (canaries -> ringed rollout -> full promotion) with programmable gates (health, latency, regression thresholds) and automatic rollback triggers.

Scope:
- Compatibility harness: preflight probe runner, dry-run schema executor (non-destructive), model-variant compatibility checker, node-level invariants check, and artifact bundling.
- Rollout sentinel: policy engine for gates, canary orchestration, backoff & circuit breaker, audit trail & runbook link injection, and integration with private upgrade conductor.
- Observability: migration-run dashboard (per-run token-level cost estimate, step durations, regression counters), export to Console traces, and retention of run artifacts for LTS certification.
- Security & compliance: signed artifacts (KMS), RBAC for who can promote LTS channels, and immutable run logs.

Non-goals: full on-prem package installer (we'll integrate with existing agent), migration content authoring UI (PM/design will follow in a separate ticket).

Why now: A set of recent private upgrade incidents highlighted lack of early compatibility checks for schema translation and model artifact mismatches. Implementing an automated compatibility-to-rollout path reduces manual coordination and shortens mean time to safe promotion for LTS channels.
acceptance_criteria: Compatibility harness runs deterministic preflight checks against a staging cluster and produces a signed artifact that includes a compatibility report and KV/schema translation log
Sentinel can execute a staged rollout described by a 3-step policy (single-node canary -> 10% ring -> 100%) and trigger automatic rollback on defined SLO regressions
All run metadata and logs are visible in Console migration-run dashboard within 10 minutes of completion
Artifact signing uses KMS keys and run records are immutable for audit review
Integration smoke test: run a dry-run upgrade that includes a schema migration and model bundle switch, and assert zero customer-facing errors in canary window
